title: Hooded Entity with Books
description: A dark surreal scene features a large hooded figure with a mechanical skull-like face and multiple outstretched arms holding open books. Below, smaller robed figures perform a ritual around a circular pattern on the ground, all rendered in a monochrome palette with glowing orbs in the background.
prompt: A towering hooded figure with a metallic skull face and many arms extending outward, each hand holding an open book, positioned above a group of smaller robed cultists performing a ritual in a circle on the ground, dark ink and charcoal style with glowing golden orbs floating in the smoky background, high contrast, detailed linework, ominous atmosphere
